_doc: The Occasions copy the seed wrote before the standalone designs (20 Nov 2026), per occasion. seed.js gives a pharmacy or promotion master it made, still holding exactly this copy for an occasion, the new default copy (pharmacies.json); copy anyone edited is kept. Equal to LEGACY_OCCASION_COPY in ../../js/render.js (seed/test/seed.test.js checks).
